title: situation.confederate_capital_moved.title
railroad: [I] R48: use Davis's arrival on 29 May as the effective move of the principal's seat; this does not date the removal of every department. docs/research/_parts/I-richmond.md, item 2, OR IV-1 p. 361; RR1 Diary p. 84.

gate.none: The president's administrative seat and dispatch destination; no secession argument, war aim, civilian consequence or prisoner policy.

citations.at: IV-1 p. 361: Davis's Richmond-dated telegram, 29 May 1861. docs/research/_parts/I-richmond.md, item 2; corroborated there by Rebellion Record vol. 1, Diary p. 84 (arrival that morning). Resolution agreed 20 May and approved 21 May: OR IV-1 pp. 342-343; War Department move ordered 25 May: p. 354. [I] Arrival is the effective capital date for routing.
